meta.title: Emrah Çabkur — Bahçeşehir Hairdresser & Echosline Ambassador
meta.description: Emrah Çabkur is the founder of Emrahair and Echosline Türkiye Ambassador, a Bahçeşehir specialist in Air Touch balayage, color and cuts. Book with Emrah.

lede: Emrahair was founded under Emrah Çabkur’s name and built with his own hands. At his salon in Bahçeşehir 1. Kısım he works in balayage, color and cutting, and today he is the Türkiye Ambassador for the Italian hair care brand Echosline.
imageAlt: Emrah Çabkur applying color with foils to a guest’s hair in the brick-walled salon

sections.heading: Areas of expertise
body: Color is at the heart of Emrah Çabkur’s work: Air Touch balayage, balayage, sombré, ombré, brushlight, highlights and blonde shades lightened without damaging the hair. Women’s haircuts, keratin treatments, and bridal and engagement hair are also part of the work done in his chair.
The balayage and color work he shares on his Instagram account @emrahair ranks at the top of Google for the search “bahçeşehir balyaj”.

sections.heading: Echosline Türkiye Ambassador
body: Echosline is an Italian professional hair care and color brand. As the brand’s ambassador in Türkiye, Emrah Çabkur takes part in its color events and works with its color range at his salon.

sections.heading: What guests say
body: “Verdiği bilgilendirmeler, kullandığı ürünler ve titizliğiyle güven veren Emrah Bey’e çok teşekkür ederim.” (“Many thanks to Emrah, whose explanations, products and care inspire trust.”) The words that come up most in Kolay Randevu reviews are clear explanations, trust and attention to detail.
Emrahair is rated 4.9 from 297 reviews on Kolay Randevu and 4.8 from 43 reviews on Google.

sections.heading: The team
body: Working alongside Emrah Çabkur at Emrahair are Serdar Sezer in cutting and color, Merve and Zeynep Aydemir in color and blowouts, and Gizem Değişener in nails, brows and waxing.
